summary: Focused re-test of the reported driver-signup bug ('nothing happens on Register'). Frontend Playwright (mobile 430x950) on /driver/signup verified: (1) submitting an empty form now shows the red banner [data-testid=driver-signup-error] with the exact list 'Please fill: Full name, Phone, Email, Password, Vehicle, Home base postcode, Licence number, Insurance policy no.' — no silent stall; (2) happy path with all required fields + default pre-filled rates (35/40/45/50/5/15) posts /api/auth/driver-register, receives 200, sets user, and navigates to /driver; (3) Driver Hub renders [data-testid=driver-pending-banner] 'Application under review — We're verifying your documents...' plus success toast. Backend contract re-verified via curl: missing home_postcode -> 422; full payload -> 200 with role=driver. Backend pytest regression suite (25 tests from iteration_3): 23 passed, 2 flaky failures under pytest-xdist in TestInstantOffers (test_select_driver_invalid_payment_type, test_cannot_double_assign) — both hit `offers[0]` IndexError because the /instant-offers list came back empty when tests run concurrently against a shared driver dataset. These were 100% green in iteration_3 (same test file, same server code) so it is a parallel-fixture race, not a functional regression, and unrelated to driver-signup. Full customer marketplace regression already validated end-to-end in iteration_3.

minor.issue: Flaky under pytest-xdist parallel workers — returns empty offers list intermittently when multiple TestInstantOffers cases race on the same approved-driver fixture, causing IndexError in tests. Non-blocking; likely fixture scoping issue in backend_test.py (approved_driver fixture may need class scope or unique home_postcode per test).

action_items: Driver signup bug is FIXED — user can safely retry on the preview URL. If the user's live/deployed site still shows 'nothing happens', it is a stale build and needs redeploy.

(Low priority) Stabilise TestInstantOffers fixtures so /instant-offers reliably returns >=1 offer under xdist — e.g. give each test its own approved_driver + unique pickup postcode, or move approved_driver fixture to function scope with deterministic seeding.
critical_code_review_comments: DriverSignup submit() validates only required strings; rate fields are numeric and pre-filled but user could still enter out-of-band values (e.g. small=100). Frontend accepts them and relies on backend to clamp — consider a client-side range hint/toast so drivers understand the band is enforced.
Password rule is 6+ chars only; consider aligning with playbook (>=8 + complexity) and adding a strength meter.

formatApiError(err.response?.data?.detail) may produce '[object Object]' for FastAPI 422 validation payloads (list of dicts). Verify formatApiError handles the array-of-{loc,msg,type} shape gracefully — otherwise a legitimate backend rejection could look confusing to drivers.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Driver signup bug fix verified end-to-end. If retesting: use mobile viewport 430x950, POST payload requires pricing.rates.{small,medium,large,xl} + stairs_fee + helper_rate all clamped to bands; home_postcode is required (422 otherwise). Pending banner testid is 'driver-pending-banner'; error banner testid is 'driver-signup-error'. Playwright inside mcp_browser_automation is ASYNC — must `await` page.query_selector/text_content/etc. The 2 flaky TestInstantOffers failures are a fixture-race under xdist, not a functional regression (iteration_3 had them at 100%).
rca of the issue: Root cause of the original 'nothing happens on Register' bug: the previous DriverSignup form used native HTML `required` attributes on the newly-added home_postcode + rate inputs. On mobile the native validation tooltip triggered on submit but was invisible to the user (viewport/scroll issue), leaving the form appearing to do nothing. Fix (already applied by main agent and verified here): form now uses `noValidate`, submit() performs explicit JS validation, sets a visible red [data-testid=driver-signup-error] banner listing missing fields, scrolls to top, and numeric rate fields fall back to per-band defaults via `num()`. Confirmed by Playwright: empty submit shows the banner; full submit posts /api/auth/driver-register, receives 200, and navigates to /driver with the pending banner.
